evidence: Has the Wallet label and modifies external signer PSBT handling in src/external_signer.cpp and test/functional/wallet_signer.py.
rationale: Prevents potential fund loss from compromised or malfunctioning external signers tampering with transactions. Previously, the wallet replaced PSBTs wholesale, allowing a signer to 'change output scripts, divert amounts to fees, finalize inputs, or use sighash types that allow third parties to modify outputs after signing' (PR description and commit ecaf464249).
